summary: AlembicCore P3 implemented a deterministic host-agent completeness critic primitive in commit 946df285ecbfb777dffc1fc4dccc1aed6118adfd. The primitive accepts dimensionId, miningGuidance, projectInfoTree/projectFacts, submitted Recipes/sourceRefs, target/floor counts, noPadding, and exhaustedReason; emits grounded uncoveredPattern hints with source refs or an exhausted/insufficient-evidence status; sorts guidance/hints by importance; avoids covered refs and invented ungrounded hints; preserves floor=3/noPadding and keeps targetPerDimension=5 advisory with shouldBlockCompletion=false. Exported through the host-agent workflow facade. No Plugin/MCP/daemon/provider work was added.
